description:
Coffee brewing assistant with timer, bean management, and tasting notes

Brew Guide is an all-in-one coffee brewing assistant app.
Features include brewing timer with multi-stage guidance, coffee bean inventory management,
brewing notes with ratings and flavor profiles, and cloud sync support.
- Add desktop MCP connections and authorized data access for third-party Android apps.
- Add combined coffee bean filters and name sorting, remembering previous selections.
- Search or create brewing methods while manually recording a note.
- Fix coffee bean field display issues, including roast levels for blends.
- Fix transparent image handling and prerelease update detection.
